(noun). giàu

ex: We were impressed by the great richness of detail in her painting.

wildlife

(noun). Động vật hoang dã

ex: At the museum there was a diorama of local wildlife.

landscape

(noun). quang cảnh

ex: The cathedral dominates the landscape for miles around.

concept

(noun). Khái niệm, ý tưởng

ex: The concept of free speech is unknown to them.

admission

(noun). thừa nhận

ex: Her silence was taken as an admission of guilt/defeat.

reform

(verb). cải cách

ex: Who will reform our unfair electoral system?

lie at the heart of something

(phrase). trở thành trọng tâm, cốt lõi của thứ gì đó

ex: The questions of training and pay lie at the heart of the staffing problems.

consequence

(noun). Hậu quả

ex: I told the hairdresser to do what she wanted to my hair, and look at the consequences!

existence

(noun). Sự tồn tại

ex: The theatre company that they started is still in existence today.

cycle

(noun). chu kỳ

ex: Cycles cannot be taken on this train.

humanity

(noun). nhân loại

ex: Bombing civilians is a crime against humanity .

consequence

(noun). Hậu quả

ex: The slightest error can have serious consequences.

justifiably

(adverb). một cách có thể bào chữa

ex: He was justifiably proud of his achievements.

notion

(noun). Khái niệm

ex: I have only a vague notion of what she does for a living.

reluctant

(adjective). không nguyện ý

ex: I was having such a good time I was reluctant to leave.

package

(noun). Bao bì

ex: The courier has just delivered a package for you.

resurrect

(verb). làm sống lại

ex: She has been busily trying to resurrect her Hollywood career.

prime

(noun). thời hoàng kim

ex: This is a dancer in her prime.

moratorium

(noun). cấm vận

ex: a five-year worldwide moratorium on nuclear weapons testing

squander

(verb). phung phí

ex: Ireland squandered several chances, including a penalty that cost them the game.

purification

(noun). thanh lọc

ex: Probably the widest field is still in the purification of iron and steel

nutrient

(noun). Chất dinh dưỡng

ex: A healthy diet should provide all your essential nutrients.

storage

(noun). lưu trữ

ex: She'd been in the large storage room once while playing hide and seek long ago.

ramification

(noun). tình tiết rắc rối

ex: Have you considered all the ramifications of your suggestion?

edifice

(noun). toà nhà

ex: The town hall is the only edifice surviving from the 15th century.

deliberate

(adjective). cố ý

ex: We made a deliberate decision to live apart for a while.

captivity

(noun). sự giam giữ

ex: All the hostages, when released from captivity, looked remarkably fit and well.
